title: OnboardingCase
description: A supplier onboarding/qualification workflow instance. Buyer-internal, transactional. Produces or refreshes a SupplierQualification. The workflow states are stable and normative; the credential types it collects are extensible and may evolve (manual attestation today, issuer-signed credentials later) without changing this lifecycle.

initiatingParty.description: The buyer / procuring entity running the case.

caseType.description: A revalidation or remediation is a NEW case against an EXISTING qualification, not a re-onboard.

eligibilityPolicy.description: Reference to the eligibility Policy the case is assessed against.

requiredCredentialTypes.description: The credential types this case requires (the extensible layer). See codelists/credentialType.csv.

collectedCredentials.description: Verified facts gathered during the case.

decision.description: The qualification Decision (decisionType: qualification) that closed the case.

producesQualification.description: The SupplierQualification this case creates or refreshes.

period.description: When the case opened and closed.
